title: Learning instruments from jew's harp to bass, played left-handed
summary: He began at about ten on the jew's harp, moved through harmonica, guitar, mandolin, violin and tuba to bass pedal, and played left-handed.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
